title: Pattaya Gym Directory — Recently Added
description: Latest verified gyms, Muay Thai camps, dive operators, golf courses and sport venues added to the Pattaya Gym Directory.

items.title: Fairtex Training Center Pattaya
items.content_text: Muay Thai and BJJ centre with published drop-in, multi-session, monthly and accommodation packages.

items.title: Sityodtong Muay Thai Camp
items.content_text: Historic East Pattaya Muay Thai camp offering adult and children's training, private lessons, pad work and small-group sessions.

items.title: ISS Boxing and Muay Thai
items.content_text: Pattaya Klang gym with boxing and Muay Thai classes plus separate gym-access passes.

items.title: Kombat Group Thailand
items.content_text: Huai Yai residential camp with all-inclusive Muay Thai, boxing, MMA and BJJ programmes.

items.title: Battle & Conquer Gym
items.content_text: Pratamnak Muay Thai gym with twice-daily group training, a weights area, sauna and cold plunge.

items.title: Sor Klinmee Gym
items.content_text: Nong Prue Muay Thai camp with morning and afternoon/evening training periods.

items.title: Petchrungruang Gym
items.content_text: Family Muay Thai camp in South Pattaya offering group training for different experience levels.

items.title: Rambaa Somdet M16
items.content_text: East Pattaya Muay Thai and MMA gym with two listed training periods Monday-Saturday.

items.title: BOXING CLUB Mixfight Pattaya
items.content_text: Khao Makok combat school offering Muay Thai, boxing, MMA and jiu-jitsu, with current venue activity and independent event records.

items.title: Venum Training Camp Thailand
items.content_text: Soi Khopai combat-sports camp with Muay Thai, boxing, MMA, BJJ and cross-training.

items.title: ALFA BJJ Pattaya
items.content_text: Closed former BJJ academy whose instructor redirected students to Rage Fight Academy.

items.title: Sanit Sport Club
items.content_text: Pong fitness facility with current activity including aerobics; a current Muay Thai programme could not be verified.

items.title: Lumpinee Boxing Stadium
items.content_text: Active Bangkok stadium hosting scheduled Muay Thai events, including Friday ONE Lumpinee and Saturday Lumpinee Super Champ cards.

items.title: Rajadamnern Stadium
items.content_text: Bangkok Muay Thai stadium with a current seven-night event calendar; not a Pattaya venue.

items.title: Rage Fight Academy
items.content_text: South Pattaya combat camp offering Muay Thai, boxing, BJJ, MMA and functional training.

items.title: Silk Muay Thai
items.content_text: Residential East Pattaya Muay Thai camp offering group and private training, accommodation, meals, pool, sauna and spa access.

items.title: Sudsakorn Muay Thai Gym
items.content_text: East Pattaya Muay Thai gym with morning and afternoon training six days a week and published drop-in, weekly and monthly rates.

items.title: Soi Seven MuayThai
items.content_text: Active Muay Thai gym on Jomtien Soi 7, now using the operator name Soi Seven MuayThai.

items.title: FIGHT EVO360
items.content_text: Muay Thai gym with wrestling, strength, yoga, open gym and children's sessions; facility hours are published but class times require confirmation.

items.title: Sitpholek Institute of Muay Thai Techniques
items.content_text: Khao Talo Muay Thai gym with direct trainer-led instruction for beginners and experienced trainees.

items.title: Jungle Gym Pattaya (former CrossFit Pattaya affiliate)
items.content_text: Functional-fitness gym whose CrossFit official directory entry is now marked departed.

items.title: Tony's Fitness Group
items.content_text: South Pattaya Third Road weight-training gym with round-the-clock listing hours.

items.title: Platinum Fitness Club
items.content_text: Legacy record retained for identity tracking; current Pattaya operation could not be verified.

items.title: Coco Fitness
items.content_text: Central Pattaya commercial gym on the fourth floor of Mike Shopping Mall.

items.title: Universe Gym
items.content_text: Welcome Town commercial gym with cardio, resistance and free-weight training areas.

items.title: Fitz Club — Racquets, Health & Fitness
items.content_text: Royal Cliff sports club with gym, pool, tennis, squash, table tennis and a convertible multipurpose court; day visitors are welcome.

items.title: Elite Gym & Fitness Pattaya
items.content_text: Air-conditioned Sukhumvit Road gym offering general training, group classes and personal training.

items.title: Jetts Fitness Little Walk Pattaya
items.content_text: Jetts club at Little Walk Pattaya with 24-hour member access and published staffed hours.

items.title: Anytime Fitness Pattaya
items.content_text: Two Pattaya branches offering 24-hour member access, strength and cardio equipment, classes and personal training.

items.title: Fitness 7 Pattaya
items.content_text: Twenty-four-hour gym at The Avenue Pattaya with cardio, resistance, free-weight, boxing and functional areas.
